cli.description: CLI for Vergil Astro theme — write, publish, and create

cli.json: Print one JSON document to stdout instead of text
cli.init: Create a Vergil site from the theme's starter, in a new folder <dir> or the current directory
cli.init.template: GitHub repo of the theme (default: vergil-astro/vergil-astro-theme)
cli.init.ref: Tag, branch or commit of the theme repo (default: the latest release)
cli.init.from: Use a local checkout of the theme repo instead of downloading it
cli.init.theme: Version spec of @vergil-astro/theme to depend on (default: ^ the version of that release)
cli.init.skipServe: Skip starting dev server after init
cli.new: Create new content. Types: post, page, project, album, thought, moment, doc
cli.new.repo: GitHub repo, owner/repo or URL (for projects)
cli.publish: Publish a draft (remove draft flag). Without a slug, pick from a list (terminal only).
cli.list: List content — `vg list` for summary, `vg list <type>` for items
cli.series: Manage post series — `vg series` lists, `vg series <name>` shows one
cli.series.list: List all series and post counts
cli.series.show: Show all posts in a series
cli.docs: Browse documentation books — `vg docs` lists, `vg docs <book>` shows one
cli.docs.list: List all books with chapter counts
cli.docs.show: Show a book as a chapter tree
cli.skin: Install and manage skins (skins/<name>/, enabled in identity.ts). Each skin brings its own color schemes
cli.skin.add: Install a skin: a name from vergil-astro/vergil-skins, a GitHub repo or folder in one (owner/repo[/folder][#ref]), or a local folder
cli.skin.add.name: Install under this name
cli.skin.add.noEnable: Don't add it to skins in identity.ts
cli.skin.list: List built-in, installed and enabled skins
cli.skin.use: Make a skin the default for visitors who haven't picked one
cli.skin.update: Re-fetch installed skins from where they were installed from
cli.skin.remove: Disable a skin and delete its folder
cli.images: Tidy and check the images your posts use (src/assets/img/, referenced as @img/)
cli.images.organize: Move each post's images under src/assets/img/ and rewrite the references as @img/
cli.images.check: Report image references that point to missing files
cli.images.expand: Rewrite @img/ references as plain relative paths, e.g. for editors that cannot resolve @img/
cli.directives: Check and look up content directives, using the rules of the theme this site runs
cli.directives.check: Check directive syntax in src/content, or only in the given files
cli.directives.ref: Print the directive reference as Markdown, or only the named directives
cli.reset: Clear the sample content for a clean start; keeps the Vergil guide unless --all
cli.reset.all: Also remove the Vergil guide docs
cli.upgrade: Upgrade the theme package on a new branch, run the migrations it needs, and compare the site before and after
cli.upgrade.to: Upgrade to this version instead of the latest
cli.upgrade.skipCheck: Skip building and comparing the site before and after
cli.help: Directive help from this site's theme: `vg help directives`, `vg help callout`
cli.lang: Show the display language, or set it: `vg lang zh`, `vg lang en`
